# London Furnace Repair

> Heating and cooling requests for London. Furnace repair covers diagnosis of no-start, weak or cold airflow, short cycling, ignition, blower, control, combustion, and venting faults in forced-air furnaces.

Phone: +15484572462  |  Email: contact@londonfurnacerepair.ca  |  Website: https://londonfurnacerepair.ca

Request locations: London, St. Thomas, Strathroy, Dorchester, Komoka, Aylmer, Lucan. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
